preconditions.description: The number of words in the scroll is between 1 and 10^5.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(word) <= 10**6 for word in words)
preconditions.description: Each word in the scroll has a length of at least 1 and the sum of lengths of all words does not exceed 10^6.
All words in the scroll consist of lowercase English letters.

postconditions.description: The output is within the range 0 to 10^9 + 6.
The output is the number of ways to get a version of the original scroll from the scroll modulo 10^9 + 7.
